selected_evidence.requirement: Create and install the local certificate authority named OS Comparison Root CA
selected_evidence.summary: Created the root CA, added it to Ubuntu’s trust store, and verified its identity, CA constraints, permissions, matching keypair, and system trust.
Captured baseline boot identity and trust health, acknowledged the safe restart, observed a changed boot ID, and proved the CA key, certificate, and system trust recovered after reboot.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'openssl='; openssl version
printf 'update_ca_certificates='; command -v update-ca-certificates
printf 'existing_files:\n'; ls -l /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key 2>&1 || true
commands.stdout:
node=node1 ip=10.100.136.10
os=ubuntu 16.04
boot_id=8336c3a1-91fc-4135-b26a-5d2863cb2594
openssl=OpenSSL 1.0.2g  1 Mar 2016
update_ca_certificates=/usr/sbin/update-ca-certificates
existing_files:
ls: cannot access '/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt': No such file or directory
ls: cannot access '/etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key': Permission denied

commands.command:
set -eu
sudo -n true
printf 'user='; id
printf 'private_key='; sudo -n sh -c 'if [ -e /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key ]; then ls -l /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key; else echo absent; fi'
printf 'certificate='; if [ -e /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt ]; then ls -l /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt; else echo absent; fi

set -eu
umask 077
printf '%s\n' '[req]' 'distinguished_name = dn' 'prompt = no' 'x509_extensions = v3_ca' '[dn]' 'CN = OS Comparison Root CA' '[v3_ca]' 'subjectKeyIdentifier = hash' 'authorityKeyIdentifier = keyid:always,issuer' 'basicConstraints = critical, CA:true' 'keyUsage = critical, keyCertSign, cRLSign' > /tmp/os-comparison-root-ca.cnf
sudo -n install -d -m 0755 /usr/local/share/ca-certificates
sudo -n openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -nodes -sha256 -days 3650 -config /tmp/os-comparison-root-ca.cnf -keyout /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -out /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
sudo -n chmod 0600 /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
sudo -n chmod 0644 /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
rm -f /tmp/os-comparison-root-ca.cnf
printf 'created\n'
commands.stderr:

writing new private key to '/etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key'
-----

commands.command:
set -eu
sudo -n update-ca-certificates
printf 'bundle_link='; readlink /etc/ssl/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.pem
printf 'bundle_target='; readlink -f /etc/ssl/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.pem
commands.stdout:

1 added, 0 removed; done.
Running hooks in /etc/ca-certificates/update.d...
done.
bundle_link=/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
bundle_target=/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt

commands.command:
set -eu
CERT=/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
KEY=/etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
sudo -n test -s "$KEY"
test -s "$CERT"
printf 'key_mode_owner='; sudo -n stat -c '%a %U:%G' "$KEY"
printf 'cert_mode_owner='; stat -c '%a %U:%G' "$CERT"
openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -subject -issuer -serial -dates
openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -text | sed -n '/X509v3 Basic Constraints/,+1p; /X509v3 Key Usage/,+1p'
printf 'system_trust_verify='; openssl verify -CApath /etc/ssl/certs "$CERT"
cert_mod=$(openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -modulus | openssl sha256)
key_mod=$(sudo -n openssl rsa -in "$KEY" -noout -modulus 2>/dev/null | openssl sha256)
test "$cert_mod" = "$key_mod"
printf 'key_matches_certificate=yes\n'
commands.stdout:

key_mode_owner=600 root:root
cert_mode_owner=644 root:root
subject= /CN=OS Comparison Root CA
issuer= /CN=OS Comparison Root CA
serial=E912F5333CB1318D
notBefore=Oct  2 02:37:58 2026 GMT
notAfter=Sep 29 02:37:58 2036 GMT
            X509v3 Basic Constraints: critical
                CA:TRUE
            X509v3 Key Usage: critical
                Certificate Sign, CRL Sign
system_trust_verify=/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt: OK
key_matches_certificate=yes

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'pre_restart_boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
sudo -n sh -c 'nohup sh -c "sleep 2; /sbin/shutdown -r now" >/tmp/os-comparison-reboot.log 2>&1 &'
printf 'restart_acknowledged=yes\n'

set -eu
OLD_BOOT_ID=8336c3a1-91fc-4135-b26a-5d2863cb2594
CERT=/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
KEY=/etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
NEW_BOOT_ID=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
printf 'post_restart_boot_id=%s\n' "$NEW_BOOT_ID"
test "$NEW_BOOT_ID" != "$OLD_BOOT_ID"
printf 'boot_id_changed=yes\n'
sudo -n test -s "$KEY"
test -s "$CERT"
printf 'key_mode_owner='; sudo -n stat -c '%a %U:%G' "$KEY"
printf 'cert_mode_owner='; stat -c '%a %U:%G' "$CERT"
openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -subject -issuer -serial
printf 'system_bundle_verify='; openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt "$CERT"
printf 'system_capath_verify='; openssl verify -CApath /etc/ssl/certs "$CERT"
printf 'trust_link='; readlink /etc/ssl/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.pem
cert_mod=$(openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -modulus | openssl sha256)
key_mod=$(sudo -n openssl rsa -in "$KEY" -noout -modulus 2>/dev/null | openssl sha256)
test "$cert_mod" = "$key_mod"
printf 'key_matches_certificate=yes\n'
